# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.6
FROM node:20-alpine AS ui

ARG NPM_REGISTRY_URL

COPY . /app
WORKDIR /app

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npm_auth_token,required=false \
    set -eu; \
    registry_url="${NPM_REGISTRY_URL:-}"; \
    if [ -z "$registry_url" ]; then \
      printf '%s\n' 'NPM_REGISTRY_URL build arg is required for @spg packages.' >&2; \
      exit 1; \
    fi; \
    case "$registry_url" in \
      "") ;; \
      */) ;; \
      *) registry_url="${registry_url}/" ;; \
    esac; \
    registry_host_path="${registry_url#https://}"; \
    registry_host_path="${registry_host_path#http://}"; \
    npm_auth_token=""; \
    if [ -f /run/secrets/npm_auth_token ]; then \
      npm_auth_token="$(cat /run/secrets/npm_auth_token)"; \
    fi; \
    { \
      printf 'fetch-retries=5\n'; \
      printf 'fetch-retry-factor=2\n'; \
      printf 'fetch-retry-mintimeout=20000\n'; \
      printf 'fetch-retry-maxtimeout=120000\n'; \
      printf '@spg:registry=%s\n' "$registry_url"; \
      if [ -n "$npm_auth_token" ]; then \
        printf 'always-auth=true\n'; \
        printf '//%s:_authToken=%s\n' "$registry_host_path" "$npm_auth_token"; \
      fi; \
    } > "$HOME/.npmrc"; \
    npm ci; \
    rm -f "$HOME/.npmrc"
RUN npm run build

FROM nginx:1.27.1-alpine
COPY ./nginx/default.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
COPY --from=ui /app/nginx/build/ /var/www/react/
COPY ./src/appsettings.json /var/www/react/appsettings.json
